properties.name: serverURL
properties.description: Server url comes from the remaining endpoint. Use platform to connect to local JVM.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Format for the message body. Either xml or raw. If xml, the notification is serialized to xml. If raw, then the raw java object is set as the body.

properties.name: granularityPeriod
properties.description: The frequency to poll the bean to check the monitor (monitor types only).

properties.name: monitorType
properties.description: The type of monitor to create. One of string, gauge, counter (monitor types only).

properties.name: objectDomain
properties.description: The domain for the mbean you're connecting to

properties.name: objectName
properties.description: The name key for the mbean you're connecting to. This value is mutually exclusive with the object properties that get passed.

properties.name: observedAttribute
properties.description: The attribute to observe for the monitor bean or consumer.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: executorService
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use a custom shared thread pool for the consumers. By default each consume has their own thread-pool to process and route notifications.

properties.name: handback
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Value to handback to the listener when a notification is received. This value will be put in the message header with the key JMXConstants#JMX_HANDBACK.

properties.name: notificationFilter
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Reference to a bean that implements the NotificationFilter.

properties.name: objectProperties
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Properties for the object name. These values will be used if the objectName param is not set. This is a multi-value option with prefix: key.

properties.name: reconnectDelay
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The number of seconds to wait before attempting to retry establishment of the initial connection or attempt to reconnect a lost connection

properties.name: reconnectOnConnectionFailure
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: If true the consumer will attempt to reconnect to the JMX server when any connection failure occurs. The consumer will attempt to re-establish the JMX connection every 'x' seconds until the connection is made-- where 'x' is the configured reconnectionDelay

properties.name: testConnectionOnStartup
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: If true the consumer will throw an exception if unable to establish the JMX connection upon startup. If false, the consumer will attempt to establish the JMX connection every 'x' seconds until the connection is made -- where 'x' is the configured reconnectionDelay

properties.name: initThreshold
properties.label: counter
properties.description: Initial threshold for the monitor. The value must exceed this before notifications are fired (counter monitor only).

properties.name: modulus
properties.label: counter
properties.description: The value at which the counter is reset to zero (counter monitor only).

properties.name: offset
properties.label: counter
properties.description: The amount to increment the threshold after it's been exceeded (counter monitor only).

properties.name: differenceMode
properties.label: counter,gauge
properties.description: If true, then the value reported in the notification is the difference from the threshold as opposed to the value itself (counter and gauge monitor only).

properties.name: notifyHigh
properties.label: gauge
properties.description: If true, the gauge will fire a notification when the high threshold is exceeded (gauge monitor only).

properties.name: notifyLow
properties.label: gauge
properties.description: If true, the gauge will fire a notification when the low threshold is exceeded (gauge monitor only).

properties.name: thresholdHigh
properties.label: gauge
properties.description: Value for the gauge's high threshold (gauge monitor only).

properties.name: thresholdLow
properties.label: gauge
properties.description: Value for the gauge's low threshold (gauge monitor only).

properties.name: password
properties.label: security
properties.description: Credentials for making a remote connection

properties.name: user
properties.label: security
properties.description: Credentials for making a remote connection

properties.name: notifyDiffer
properties.label: consumer,string
properties.description: If true, will fire a notification when the string attribute differs from the string to compare (string monitor or consumer). By default the consumer will notify match if observed attribute and string to compare has been configured.

properties.name: notifyMatch
properties.label: consumer,string
properties.description: If true, will fire a notification when the string attribute matches the string to compare (string monitor or consumer). By default the consumer will notify match if observed attribute and string to compare has been configured.

properties.name: stringToCompare
properties.label: consumer,string
properties.description: Value for attribute to compare (string monitor or consumer). By default the consumer will notify match if observed attribute and string to compare has been configured.
